选择项目或包含多个项目的目录；目录内的项目和 worktree 会自动发现。: Choose a project or a parent folder to discover its projects and worktrees.
可分别选择 .codex、.claude 和 .claude.json；索引指向: Choose .codex, .claude or .claude.json. Referenced projects need their own folder access.
选择 .zsh_history、.bash_history 或自定义历史文件，恢: Choose .zsh_history, .bash_history or a custom history file to discover command shortcuts.
选择 .zshrc 等配置文件或其所在目录，保留别名和工具环境。: Choose .zshrc or its folder to keep your aliases and tool environment.
选择 .ssh、.gitconfig 等所需文件或目录。授权后应用中的命令也能访: Choose .ssh, .gitconfig or other required files. Commands in the app will also have access.
选择 Homebrew、Node 等安装目录；运行工具时还可能需要其缓存或配置目: Choose Homebrew, Node or other tool folders. Their cache and configuration may need separate access.
一次授权个人目录可保留更多自动发现和 Shell 行为，也允许应用及其命令访问目: Grant your home folder for broader discovery and shell support. This also grants access to other files in that folder. You can grant individual locations instead.
选择允许 BranchDeck 访问的目录或文件。授权会在下次启动时恢复；新的: Choose the locations BranchDeck may access. Access is restored at launch; shell configuration changes apply to new terminals. System sandbox restrictions still apply.
已停止保存授权，下次完全退出并重启后生效。: Access will no longer be saved. Fully quit and restart to finish removing it.
匹配成功的命令已显示在操作列；这里可补充关联其余命令。: Matched commands already appear in the command column. Associate additional commands here.
未记录目录的命令，导入到: Import commands without a recorded folder into
执行时会再次确认: You will be asked to confirm before running
可切换到全部目录，或选择其他历史文件。: Try all folders or choose another history file.
支持 zsh 和 bash，可手动选择自定义 HISTFILE。: Supports zsh and bash, including a custom HISTFILE.
历史通常不记录执行目录，仅命令内明确写出的绝对目录会自动关联。不会根据相邻的 c: History rarely records working directories. Only explicit absolute paths in commands are associated automatically. A nearby cd command is not used to guess the folder. Importing saves configuration without running commands.
筛选常见开发命令；疑似含凭据、删除或强制操作、复杂 Shell 表达式会跳过。仅: Common development commands are filtered for likely credentials, destructive operations and complex shell expressions. Only saved history is scanned; unsaved terminal history may not appear.
拖动调整宽度 · 双击恢复默认: Drag to resize · Double-click to reset
独立服务终端 · 停止后返回 Shell: Dedicated service terminal · Returns to a shell when stopped
可以直接输入命令 · Tab 补全 · ↑ 查看历史: Type a command · Tab to complete · ↑ for history
在同目录执行，最多等待 5 秒，随后正常结束本次进程组。: Runs in the same folder for up to 5 seconds, then terminates this process group.
每行 KEY=value，保存在本机明文配置中。: One KEY=value per line. Saved in plain text on this Mac.
执行前确认（适用于会修改工作区的命令）: Confirm before running (for commands that modify the workspace)
在可访问范围内读取 Codex、Claude Code 项目索引、终端历史中的目: Reads accessible Codex and Claude Code project indexes, folders from shell history and common development folders, then adds Git worktrees. Other local projects can be found by folder. Matches history on first discovery and suggests new commands every 5 minutes. Does not read conversation bodies or run commands automatically.
终端使用登录交互式 zsh，加载你的 Shell 配置。切换工作区或隐藏窗口会保: Terminals use interactive login zsh and load your shell configuration. Switching workspaces or hiding the window preserves sessions. Fully quitting closes terminals and managed programs.
此终端仍在运行程序或有未提交的输入。关闭会结束它的进程。: This terminal has a running program or unsubmitted input. Closing it will end its processes.
从列表移除整个仓库分组，保留文件: Remove this repository group from the list, keeping files
商店版需要授权目录后发现项目、读取历史和使用开发工具。: The store build needs folder access to discover projects, read history and use development tools.
在终端使用项目后，这里会自动发现。也可以查看全部历史或手动添加。: Commands appear as you use your project. You can also browse history or add one manually.
部分来源扫描受限: Some sources could not be scanned
每 5 分钟发现新工作区与命令: Discovers workspaces and commands every 5 minutes
从开发工具、终端历史和本地项目目录自动发现工作区。: Find workspaces from development tools, shell history and local project folders.
打开终端，开始工作: Open a terminal to get started
已导入 {0} 条{1}，可在中间列找到。: Imported {0} commands{1}. Find them in the command column.
只读 · 内容仅在打开时读取 · 不上传、不执行。分享截图前请检查个人信息。: Read-only. Contents load when opened. Nothing is uploaded or executed. Review personal information before sharing screenshots.
未找到关联文件。确认 Claude 缓存和项目目录可访问，然后刷新。: No linked files found. Check access to the Claude cache and project directory, then refresh.
选择会话或文档查看原始文本。JSONL 按原始记录展示，大文件分页读取。: Select a session or document to view its original text. JSONL shows raw records; large files are paginated.
图片无法解码，请在 Finder 中打开: Unable to decode this image. Open it in Finder.
每张表最多显示 1000 行、100 列；公式显示已保存结果: Up to 1,000 rows and 100 columns per sheet; formulas show saved results
只读预览：脚本、外部资源和链接跳转已停用: Read-only preview: scripts, external resources and navigation are disabled
文件超过 32 MB，请在 Finder 中用对应应用打开: File exceeds 32 MB. Open it with an appropriate app in Finder.
此二进制格式尚不支持内置预览，请在 Finder 中打开: This binary format is not supported. Open it in Finder.
从本机 Claude 提取聊天、下载和附件，完成后自动加入目录列表。: Recover local Claude chats, downloads and attachments, then add them to your folders.
仅保存在本机，不修改 Claude 原文件。每次扫描保存独立快照，不会自动拉取云: Saved locally without changing Claude files. Each scan creates a snapshot; cloud chats are not fetched.
未找到可恢复的聊天文件。缓存可能为空或已被清理。: No chat files found. The cache may be empty or cleared.
部分内容未恢复: Some content could not be recovered
缓存不等于完整聊天历史；正文文件可能包含同一会话的不同版本。: Cache is not a complete chat history. Files may contain multiple versions of a conversation.
在本机提取聊天、下载与附件: Recovering local chats, downloads and attachments
正在读取与去重，完成后自动加入目录列表。: Reading and deduplicating files. Results will be added to your folders.
无需保持 Claude 打开，不会修改原始文件。: Claude can stay closed. Original files remain unchanged.
仅包含本机留存内容，部分会话只有标题。: Local cached content only. Some chats have titles but no messages.
每次扫描保存独立快照，不覆盖旧结果，不拉取云端聊天。: Each scan saves a separate snapshot. Previous results stay intact; cloud chats are not fetched.
文件数包括 Markdown、JSON 等不同格式及缓存版本，不等于会话数。: File counts include different formats and cached versions, not unique conversations.
复制失败，请在详情中选择路径复制: Could not copy. Select the path in details to copy it.
